summary: Frontend-only test of chunk 3-3 on the preview prod build, as admin, sales and siteengineer, at 1440 and 390 px in Light and Night. JRN-74: all 6 next-step prompts were triggered end to end with fresh TEST_ data. (a) lead → Book site visit opened the New visit dialog with the lead's name and phone filled. (b) wizard → Record booking amount opened /bookings/<id>?pay=1 with the Post payment sheet open, plus Print allotment letter. (c) payment → Print / share receipt opened /print/receipt/<id>. (d) SGH Tower B Plastering raised 16 bills; Print bill letters opened Documents › Bulk with project, tower and dates filled and 16 rows; the stage was then undone. (e) cancel with a refund due → Pay refund switched to Bills & Receipts and opened the refund-pay dialog. (f) refund paid → Print refund letter opened Documents › Generate with Cancellation / Refund letter selected. The prompt does not block the page and is gone by about 17 s. JRN-75: the groups and steps appear in the specified order, and the 6 reports opened all have CSV/PDF and KPIs. JRN-76: 12 routes in Light and Night show 0 px sideways scroll, no bottom bar and tables as labelled cards. Items: (i) the cost sheet fits and the timing picker sits under the line name; (ii) the template list shows 'Bill raised'; (iii) pp-date, pp-inst-date, md-due, f-from and f-to use the app picker, and pp-date allows only booking date to today. Defects found: 1 backend money bug (cancel with deduction 0), a sticky totals row that covers the report cards on phones, 3 next-step gaps, and some phone overflow.

critical.issue: A deduction of 0 is ignored. `to_paise(body.deduction) if body.deduction else None` treats 0 as falsy, so the project policy (2%) applies. The model also defaults deduction to 0 (line 101), so the code can't tell 'blank' from 0. The cancel dialog preview (line 860 uses `is not None`) showed 'Refund payable ₹1,00,000'. The actual cancel forfeited the whole ₹1,00,000 and created no refund. The user is shown one amount and a different one is posted. Reproduced on TEST booking BK-2627-2464. Fix: make the field `deduction: float | None = None` and test `is not None`.

minor.issue: Completing a stage auto-generates bill letters (auto=true, 16 for Tower B). Undo voids the bills but leaves those 16 letters in the Documents register as unsent (Awaiting send 602 → 618), and they point at voided bills DM-2627-14774…14789.

ui_bugs.component: Phone stacked tables: tfoot totals row (index.css @media max-width 767px, stack-table)
ui_bugs.issue: On phones, tfoot keeps display:table-footer-group with the `sticky bottom-0 bg-ink-950` classes. It shrinks to a 113 px dark box stuck to the bottom of the screen, laid over the data cards, and its 'Total …' text is nearly unreadable. Its cells have no data-label because stackLabels only labels tbody rows. Seen on /reports/outstanding-v2 in Light and Night; it likely affects every report with a totals row. Fix: `table.stack-table tfoot{display:block;position:static}` plus labels on tfoot cells.

The pay=1 query stays in the URL after the sheet opens. Every reload, or coming back to the page, reopens the Post payment sheet. In testing, a reload after posting reopened an empty sheet over the page. This risks duplicate entry. Remove the param once the sheet has opened.

bookingId is set and the PDF preview generates (API returns 200, 67 KB). But the Who card shows Project… and 'Customer / booking…' empty, because /docgen/options with no project returns 0 bookings. The user can't see which booking is picked. Use the pickers response (or add the booking to the options) to fill project and booking.

ui_bugs.component: NextStep actions are not permission-gated (BookingWizard.jsx:285, useConstructionStatus.js:71)
ui_bugs.issue: Sales has no finance.payment.create permission, yet after a wizard save it gets the primary 'Record booking amount' button, which opens the booking with no sheet. Site Engineer can complete stages (construction.update.complete) but lacks documents.document.view, so 'Print bill letters' leads to 'Access restricted' (verified as siteengineer). That page also shows the raw permission code. Filter the actions with can().

The header 'Invite user' primary button runs off-screen (left 331, right 456 px) and is clipped. The header action row does not wrap. The sweep passes only because another primary button ('Add user') is visible.

The 4 KPI cards are 7 px wider than the screen (right edge 397 px), so their right border is clipped. The day strip is also cut off ('SU 15'). The roznamcha date field is still a browser-native date input.

issues: The Money header reads 'Bill raised → Received → Balance → Overdue → Refund', but no visible report sits under Overdue (`outstanding` is hidden in the registry). Either map a visible report to Overdue (e.g. outstanding-v2 ageing) or drop the step from JOURNEY.
The Money header wraps to 4 lines in the 260 px sidebar.
Collections (Received) shows the month column as '2026-04', wrapped onto 2 lines.
The line-name input still cuts off 'Maintenance (advance)' (scrollWidth 175 vs 157).
A lowercase 'maintenance' key shows under the timing picker and reads like an internal code.
The schedule table on the right ('Schedule — Standard CLP') runs past its card edge.
It stacks on top of the separate success toast ('Lead … created' / 'Booking cancelled'), so one save produces two toasts. Consider merging them.
The DateInput 'Clear' link shows on Record payment › Date (pp-date), which is required, because the required prop is not passed.

15 files still use type=date, e.g. Pay refund 'Paid on' (BookingOps), Documents Bulk bulk-from/bulk-to, Roznamcha, construction 'Planned' dates and Payments. These were outside the listed scope, so this is for awareness only.
'Collected this month' subtitle shows '2026-11 · cleared receipts' (ISO month).

action_items: Fix the cancel deduction=0 bug (bookings.py:921 and model line 101): the preview and the actual cancel must agree.
Fix the stack-table tfoot on phones (display:block, position:static, data-label on tfoot cells).
Remove ?pay=1 from the URL after the Record payment sheet opens.
Show the picked booking (and its project) on Documents › Generate when opened with booking_id.
Filter next-step actions by permission: payment create for 'Record booking amount', documents view for 'Print bill letters', and so on.
Let the /users header actions wrap at 390, and fix the 7 px KPI card overflow on /roznamcha.
Decide what 'Overdue' maps to in the Reports hub, since no visible report sits under it.
Optional: retire or void the auto-generated bill letters when a stage is undone.
critical_code_review_comments: NextStep.jsx: the toast id comes from the title, so two different saves with the same title replace each other. That is fine, but actions are never checked against permissions.
BookingDetail.jsx: autoRefund is set to true and never reset. If the user closes the refund dialog without paying, any later reload of the refunds list reopens it.
DateInput.jsx: the min/max comparison uses parseISO local midnight. That is fine for yyyy-mm-dd, but it would break if booking_date ever carried a time part.
phone_sweep.py: 'main action reachable' passes when any one primary button is on screen, which hid the /users 'Invite user' clipping. It also doesn't check sticky or fixed overlays such as the tfoot.

success_rate.backend: n/a (frontend only; 1 backend bug found via UI)
success_rate.frontend: ~78% (JRN-74 6/6 flows reach the target, 2 with gaps; JRN-75 pass with 1 design gap; JRN-76 core checks pass, 3 layout defects; items i–iii pass)

rca of the issue: Cancel refund mismatch: the preview endpoint passes deduction with `is not None`, but the cancel handler uses truthiness, and the request model defaults deduction to 0. So an explicit 0 becomes None and the policy % applies. Phone tfoot overlay: the REQ-146 stack CSS turns table, tbody, tr and td into blocks but leaves tfoot as table-footer-group with Tailwind `sticky bottom-0`. The browser wraps it in an anonymous table box sized to its content (113 px), and it stays stuck to the bottom of the screen over the cards.
